about: PVR INOX Limited, a theatrical exhibition company, engages in the exhibition, distribution, and production of movies in India and Sri Lanka. The company is involved in sale of movie tickets; in cinema advertisements/product displays; sale of food and beverages; and restaurant business. It also manages cinema screens; and designing, developing, operating and maintaining food courts and other food outlets.
